title: Combined intercalation and space-charge mechanism enabled high-capacity, ultrafast and long-lifespan sodium-ion storage for chalcogenide anodes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03217A, Paper
Feilong Pan, Zhao Li, Shiyu Yao, Jingyi Liu, Zhixuan Wei, Xiao Chen, Yu Xie, Fei Du
A new intercalation and space-charge mechanism is discovered in dichalcogenides for sodium-ion batteries, achieving superior capacity, rate and cycling performance.
